description: Source code for a get handler in a network management system, implementing path resolution, filtering, and data retrieval via ubus.

methods.name: get_base_path
methods.description: Extracts the base path from a query path, considering brackets and operators.

methods.name: get_next_param
methods.description: Parses the next parameter from a query path string.

methods.name: is_present_in_datamodel
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists in the data model context.

methods.name: seperator
methods.description: Parses a token to identify comparison operator and extract parameter and value.

methods.name: get_instance
methods.description: Extracts an instance identifier from a path segment.

methods.name: handle_special_escape_sequence
methods.description: Processes escape sequences in string values.

methods.name: handle_string
methods.description: Handles string comparison based on operator.

methods.name: handle_uint
methods.description: Handles unsigned integer comparison.

methods.name: handle_int
methods.description: Handles signed integer comparison.

methods.name: handle_unlong
methods.description: Handles unsigned long comparison.

methods.name: handle_long
methods.description: Handles long integer comparison.

methods.name: handle_bool
methods.description: Handles boolean comparison.

methods.name: handle_time
methods.description: Handles time comparison.

methods.name: handle_hexbin
methods.description: Handles hex/binary data comparison.

methods.name: check_values
methods.description: Dispatches value comparison based on data type.

methods.name: search_n_apply
methods.description: Searches and applies filters to data model paths.

methods.name: solve_all_filters
methods.description: Resolves all filters for a given path and parameters.

methods.name: refresh_path_list
methods.description: Updates the list of resolved paths.

methods.name: resolve_path
methods.description: Recursively resolves a query path into data model paths.

methods.name: get_resolved_paths
methods.description: Main function to get resolved data paths for a query.

methods.name: bbfdm_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves data values for specified paths and formats the output.

methods.name: bbfdm_get_names
methods.description: Retrieves names of data model parameters.

methods.name: bbfdm_get_instances
methods.description: Retrieves instances of data model parameters.

methods.name: fill_operate_schema
methods.description: Fills schema info for operation parameters.

methods.name: fill_event_schema
methods.description: Fills schema info for event parameters.

methods.name: fill_param_schema
methods.description: Fills schema info for general parameters.

methods.name: get_parameters
methods.description: Extracts parameters from blob message.

methods.name: valid_entry
methods.description: Validates if an input blob entry matches data model paths.

methods.name: get_schema_from_blob
methods.description: Extracts schema information from a blob buffer.

methods.name: bbf_dm_get_supported_dm
methods.description: Retrieves supported data model schema.
